name: cold-start-late-thunderbird
description: The MCP client starts 10 s before Thunderbird, as at login (thunderbird-mcp issue #132): Thunderbird is started while the bridge's first tools/list waits for it, past the 5 s the bridge used to wait. That tools/list is answered with Thunderbird's own list, within the client's timeout, and no notifications/tools/list_changed follows.

checks.xfail: commonpost/thunderbird-mcp#132: up to 0.19.1, tools/list fails when the client starts before Thunderbird; fixed on main, strict once a release has the fix
